retrievalRules: Load the referenced project record before making an architecture, technology, evidence, outcome, or claim-specific answer.
Use status as an answer qualifier: private-client, live-client, live, case-study, research, prototype, analytics, data-lab, and local-tool are not interchangeable.
For private-client records, expose only information allowed by that record and never infer confidential details.
Never convert catalog copy or source-attributed claims into independently verified metrics.
